notes: A Beverage Control CLONE PAGE keeps its own period. The main sheet can read 01-10 → 25-10 while a clone reads 05-10 → 15-10, and each stays where you put it — the Receipt column, the ⚠ alert, the 🔍 Deep check, the Excel and the print on each page count only the Bar Stock Issues inside THAT page’s start and end date. A pill says which period you are looking at (“main period” / “this page only”), and ✕ gives a clone back to the company’s period. 📅 Start a new month no longer moves the period — you set it yourself.
